transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to discuss the disposition of Batch 47 — the 600 adhesive-bonded components currently on hold due to cure readings falling below our normal release specification. Before I make a final decision, I need to gather the full picture. Can quality engineering walk me through the test results so far, and can maintenance confirm whether there are any equipment constraints I should be aware of — particularly regarding the thermal oven if controlled rework becomes an option?
